query:
UPDATE computations AS c
        SET is_error = true,
            error_message = CASE
                -- fresh error, or a terminal stamp superseding a retryable one
                WHEN NOT old.is_error THEN $1
                WHEN $1 NOT LIKE '%' || $4 || '%' THEN $1
                -- same retryable failure again: spend budget, promote at the cap
                WHEN old.error_retry_count + 1 >= $5 THEN $6
                ELSE $1
            END,
            error_retry_count = CASE
                WHEN NOT old.is_error THEN 0
                ELSE old.error_retry_count + 1
            END
        FROM computations AS old
        WHERE old.output_handle = c.output_handle
          AND old.transaction_id = c.transaction_id
          AND c.output_handle = $2
          AND c.transaction_id = $3
          AND c.is_completed = false
          AND (c.is_error = false OR c.error_message LIKE '%' || $4 || '%')
        RETURNING (
            NOT old.is_error
            OR $1 NOT LIKE '%' || $4 || '%'
            OR old.error_retry_count + 1 >= $5
        ) AS "state_changed!"
